lines.en: I walk lightly, afraid of being heard.
I walk hugging my own arms.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在走廊里回响。
lines.en: My steps echo in the corridor.
I sniffle as I walk.
I keep my head down, hair over my face.
I hug the wall, looking back again and again.
I stop in the middle of walking.

lines.zh: 我的鞋在地上蹭出声音。
lines.en: My shoes scuff the floor.
I avoid that closed door.
I walk slowly, as if waiting for someone.
My shoulders keep hitching.

lines.zh: 我怕脚步声把什么东西招来。
lines.en: I fear my steps might call something.
I stand in the middle of the corridor, crying.
I sit hugging my knees.
My tears never stop.
I count the tiles on the floor.

lines.zh: 我小声说了一句，没人听见。
lines.en: I whisper something; no one hears.
I bury my face in my sleeve.
I slide down the wall.
My breathing comes in catches.
I wait for someone to come for me.
I am not loud; I just stand.
My hands are very cold.
I count the cracks in the wall.
My sleeve is soaked from wiping.
I press my ear to the wall and listen.
Did you hear it too?
I don't want to be alone.
Have you seen my brother?
May I stand behind you?
Don't go; the corridor is so long.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛是红的。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes red.
Will you stay with me?
There's a sound in that room.
I don't dare go over.
Your hand is warmer than mine.
I have been waiting here all along.
I wipe my face and it isn't clean.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了走廊的灯。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks the corridor light.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，没说话。
lines.en: I hold your sleeve and say nothing.
I flinch and crouch.
It hurts. I can't get up.
I hug my arm and back away.
Why would you do that?
I bite my lip and stay quiet.
My knee is scraped.
I cry harder.

lines.zh: 我抓着墙上的裂缝站起来。
lines.en: I pull myself up on a wall crack.
I was only standing. Nothing more.
I slowly retreat to the corner.
I don't want food.
Will you sit with me a while?
I'm not hungry; I'm just scared.
That sound again.
Listen, it's right behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我不想要东西，我想要人。
lines.en: I don't want things; I want someone.
Don't tease me with that.
I pulled my hand back.
You can leave it there.
You bumped me and I nearly fell.
I cling to your arm and don't let go.
Don't push me away.
I back to the wall and curl up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我抖了一下。
lines.en: We bump and I flinch.
I catch your hem.
I'm too light to hurt you.
Don't raise your hand suddenly.
I'm still little. I shouldn't ask.
I don't understand these things.
Holding my hand is enough.
I only want someone with me.
I hold your sleeve and won't let go.
Don't leave me behind.
Sitting together is enough.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在你的手臂上。
lines.en: I rest my head on your arm.
Now I'm not afraid.
Promise you won't go.
Is this yours?
I found it. Here.
It feels a little cold in my hand.

lines.zh: 这块糖纸，我抱得紧紧的。
lines.en: I hold this candy wrapper tight.
I don't dare hold it long.
May I have this?
I picked it up and put it down.
Both my arms are already full.

lines.zh: 谢谢你，我一直没人说话。
lines.en: Thank you. I've had no one to talk to.
You hit me. I heard it.
I back away and hit the wall.
I don't want to fight, but you won't stop.
Don't come closer; the wall's behind me.
I raise a hand, very weakly.
My eyes are redder now.
Why did you hit me?
This is all I can do.
You knocked my things down.
I wipe my face.
I follow you, not daring to come close.
Where you go, I go.
I follow you, two steps behind.
Don't look back at me.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步就安心。
lines.en: Hearing your steps calms me.
You stop, and so do I.
I dare not go back alone.
That door sounded again.
I follow, holding your hem.
I count the steps quietly.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，怕走丢。
lines.en: I follow your steps, afraid of getting lost.
When you speed up, I jog two steps.
When the light blinks, I grip you tighter.
My fist has little strength.
Don't hit back; I'm not strong.
I claw your hand, nails soft.
I hit you while crying.
I bump you and pull back.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you.
I don't want this.
I know I can't beat you.
I only want you to stop.
The corridor light is too bright.
I can't find the way out.
Someone is crying. It's me.
I hug my own arms.
It's so cold here; the floor is like ice.
I hear music far off.
I crouch and hide my head.
I drew circles on the wall.
Is someone calling me?
I crouch in the corner.
There are handprints on this wall.
The fire is hot; I hide behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，膝盖磕在地上。
lines.en: I fell and my knee hit the floor.

lines.zh: 响声太大，我捂住耳朵蹲下。
lines.en: Too loud; I cover my ears and crouch.
Something hit my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我浑身发冷。
lines.en: Violet light makes me cold all over.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没吃过一顿饭。
lines.en: It has been long since I had a meal.

lines.zh: 雷声响的时候我缩成一团。
lines.en: At the thunder I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么都抓不到。
lines.en: I fall and catch nothing.
